Price +1 bonus; Aura moderate necromancy; CL 5th; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

If a soul trapping weapon kills a creature with a critical hit, it traps the creature’s soul in a soul stone as per the soul trap spell from this book. You must have an adequate crystal or stone available for this effect to work, see the material components of the spell for more details. If you have multiple stones usable with this effect, the soul trapping weapon will transfer the soul into the stone that most closely matches the requirements of the soul.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost: +1 bonus Craft Magic Arms and Armor, soul trap
